source.description: Approved handmade raster graphite and colored-pencil process contact sheet.
source.notes: One three-quarter-view ceramic teapot; no cups, lettering, arrows, UI, signatures, or watermarks.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels build an oval body scaffold into the pot silhouette, spout and handle, lid and ceramic details, graphite/color value, then a finishing-only pass.

progression_contract.blank_page_test: A beginner can copy Panel 1 in under two minutes using one body ellipse, a center axis, one spout route, one handle route, and two base ticks.

anchor_map.early_mark: One broad body ellipse with vertical center axis
anchor_map.fixed_relationship: The lid stays centered above the axis and the base remains below the same ellipse.
anchor_map.construction_note: Pale construction only; no finished pot contour in Panel 1.

anchor_map.fixed_relationship: It attaches at the upper-left body and ends above the pot midpoint.
Both handle ends attach to the right body edge and remain behind the body overlap.

final_elements.name: teapot construction guides
final_elements.description: One broad body ellipse, center axis, lid axis, spout route, handle route, and two base ticks.

final_elements.name: teapot body base and open rim
final_elements.description: One rounded three-quarter ceramic pot body with an oval top opening on a shallow oval foot.

final_elements.name: spout and handle
final_elements.description: One tapered left spout and one loop handle attached behind the right side.

final_elements.name: lid insert knob and ceramic accents
final_elements.description: One oval lid insert nested inside the established top rim, one small round knob, two highlight reserves, and a few subtle ceramic contour marks.

final_elements.name: graphite and muted glaze color
final_elements.description: Directional graphite with muted blue-green glaze, warm-gray ceramic shadow, and a broken ground shadow.

overlap_reservations.foreground_element: teapot body base and open rim
overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The handle route remains behind the body reserve and no dark handle line crosses the pot silhouette.

frames.visible_job: Place one broad body ellipse, one center axis, a lid axis, one left spout route, one right handle route, and two base ticks.
must_not_show: lid insert knob highlights shading or color

frames.visible_job: Connect the rounded body, oval top opening, and shallow foot over the established guides.
introduces: teapot body base and open rim
establishes: teapot body base and open rim
must_not_show: lid insert knob highlights shading or color

frames.visible_job: Wrap the routes with one tapered spout and one loop handle, keeping both attachments fixed to the body.
must_not_show: lid insert knob highlights graphite value or color
requires_prior_elements: teapot body base and open rim

frames.visible_job: Nest one oval lid insert inside the established top rim, then add one small knob, two highlight reserves, and restrained ceramic contour marks.
introduces: lid insert knob and ceramic accents
establishes: lid insert knob and ceramic accents
must_not_show: heavy graphite completed color or new props
requires_prior_elements: teapot body base and open rim

frames.visible_job: Add directional graphite, muted blue-green glaze, warm-gray shadow planes, and the broken ground shadow only to established forms.
adds: all planned value and color regions
must_not_show: new contours attachments lid parts highlights or props
requires_prior_elements: teapot body base and open rim
lid insert knob and ceramic accents

must_persist: teapot body base and open rim
new_occlusions: The body overlaps the inner ends of the handle.

must_persist: teapot body base and open rim
teapot body base and open rim
lid insert knob and ceramic accents
teapot body base and open rim
lid insert knob and ceramic accents

final_step.visible_job: Only strengthen established keeper contours, deepen the existing graphite and glaze, and clarify the two highlights and shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject a detailed first panel or a sheet where spout or handle attachment shifts.
Reject a final that introduces a lid, knob, highlight, color region, or shadow absent earlier.
Reject vector-like linework, polished poster rendering, or repeated darkened tracings.
